titulo.estudio: Lire plusieurs documents : Observer les formes
titulo.alumno: Reading several documents: vocabulary and forms

intro: Combine information from a poster, a timetable and a short message. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Combine information from a poster, a timetable and a short message. First look for names, days, places and figures: in notices and forms these are usually easy to find.
Point to note: compare date, place and condition across documents; do not assume two similar figures refer to the same thing. In this passage, «heure» means «hour».

frases.estudio: Le billet coûte quatre euros et le rendez-vous est devant l'entrée principale.
frases.alumno: The ticket costs four euros and the meeting point is in front of the main entrance.

frases.estudio: Le musée ferme à dix-sept heures; la visite dure une heure.
frases.alumno: The museum closes at five; the visit lasts one hour.
